examples.title: Animate a graphic into frame
examples.code:
# Create a visible source so this example runs in an empty script.
graphic = nuke.createNode("ColorWheel")
graphic.setName("Graphic")

transform = nuke.createNode("Transform")
transform.setName("Graphic_entrance")
transform.setInput(0, graphic)

start = int(nuke.root()["first_frame"].value())
finish = start + 12

# Animate the graphic from the left while it settles into scale and rotation.
transform["translate"].setAnimated()
transform["translate"].setValueAt(-300.0, start, 0)
transform["translate"].setValueAt(0.0, finish, 0)
transform["translate"].setValueAt(0.0, start, 1)
transform["translate"].setValueAt(0.0, finish, 1)

transform["scale"].setAnimated()
transform["scale"].setValueAt(0.85, start, 0)
transform["scale"].setValueAt(1.0, finish, 0)
transform["scale"].setValueAt(0.85, start, 1)
transform["scale"].setValueAt(1.0, finish, 1)

transform["rotate"].setAnimated()
transform["rotate"].setValueAt(-8.0, start)
transform["rotate"].setValueAt(0.0, finish)

# Use smooth filtering and enable subtle motion blur for the move.
transform["filter"].setValue("cubic")
transform["motionblur"].setValue(0.5)
transform["shutter"].setValue(0.5)
